intro: From April 12 to August 4, 2026, ZCyberNews covered 88 supply-chain incidents, with 16 critical and 51 high-severity findings. Lazarus Group, TeamPCP, and CanisterSprawl were among the threat actors observed. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-1731, CVE-2026-45033, CVE-2026-39987, CVE-2026-41650, and CVE-2026-44664. Affected sectors spanned technology, software development, cryptocurrency, logistics, and manufacturing, with impacts reported globally across North America, Europe, Asia, and the United States.
